# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.2 Worker 1: Celestial subjects, charter goals, zone names and track texts (oe_cel_, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v112_celestial_subjects.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Celestial Princely Fief (宗藩): level 2, joins all wars, returns to the throne without an heir.
oe_cel_fanwang = {
	type = location
	level = 2
	color = subject_vassal
	subject_pays = oe_cel_subject_pays_fanwang
	annullment_favours_required = 20

	join_offensive_wars_always = {
		NOT = { scope:actor ?= { is_subject_of = scope:recipient } }
	}
	join_offensive_wars_can_call = {
		scope:actor ?= { is_subject_of = scope:recipient }
	}
	join_defensive_wars_always = {
		always = yes
	}
	allow_declaring_wars = {
		always = no
	}

	diplomatic_capacity_cost_scale = 0.35
	strength_vs_overlord = -0.40
	has_overlords_ruler = no
	will_join_independence_wars = yes
	overlord_inherit_if_no_heir = yes
	annexation_speed = 1
	annexation_min_years_before = 20
	annexation_min_opinion = 150
	annexation_stall_opinion = 125
	overlord_can_cancel = yes
	subject_can_cancel = no
	has_limited_diplomacy = yes
	can_change_rank = no
	can_change_heir_selection = yes

	can_overlord_build_roads = yes
	can_overlord_build_buildings = yes
	can_overlord_recruit_regiments = yes
	fleet_basing_rights = yes
	food_access = yes

	great_power_score_transfer = 0.25
	institution_spread_to_overlord = monthly_institution_spread_mild
	institution_spread_to_subject = monthly_institution_spread_mild

	overlord_modifier = {
		monthly_prestige = 0.02
	}
	subject_modifier = {
		loyalty_to_overlord = 10
	}

	creation_visible = {
		oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
	}
	visible = {
		oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
		scope:target ?= {
			NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_yp_xingsheng }
			NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_yp_frontier }
		}
	}
	visible_through_diplomacy = { always = no }
	enabled_through_diplomacy = { always = no }
	visible_through_treaty = { always = no }

	on_enable = {
		scope:future_overlord ?= { save_scope_as = oe_cel_lord }
		oe_cel_apply_track_subject_flavor = yes
		scope:future_overlord ?= { oe_cel_sync_duhu_count = yes }
	}
	on_disable = {
		oe_cel_clear_track_subject_flavor = yes
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:former_overlord }
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_former_subject_of value = scope:former_overlord }
		}
	}
}

# Grand Protectorate (四海大都护府): level 2, shares exploration and merchant power; named by zone and track.
oe_cel_grand_duhu = {
	type = location
	level = 2
	color = subject_vassal
	subject_pays = oe_cel_subject_pays_duhu
	annullment_favours_required = 20

	join_offensive_wars_always = {
		NOT = { scope:actor ?= { is_subject_of = scope:recipient } }
	}
	join_offensive_wars_can_call = {
		scope:actor ?= { is_subject_of = scope:recipient }
	}
	join_defensive_wars_always = {
		always = yes
	}
	allow_declaring_wars = {
		always = no
	}

	diplomatic_capacity_cost_scale = 0.25
	strength_vs_overlord = -0.40
	has_overlords_ruler = no
	will_join_independence_wars = yes
	can_be_annexed = no
	overlord_can_cancel = yes
	subject_can_cancel = no
	has_limited_diplomacy = yes
	can_change_rank = no
	can_change_heir_selection = yes

	overlord_share_exploration = yes
	shares_exploration_with_overlord = yes
	merchants_to_overlord_fraction = 0.30
	can_overlord_build_roads = yes
	can_overlord_build_buildings = yes
	can_overlord_build_rgos = yes
	can_overlord_build_ships = yes
	can_overlord_recruit_regiments = yes
	fleet_basing_rights = yes
	food_access = yes

	great_power_score_transfer = 0.30
	institution_spread_to_overlord = monthly_institution_spread_mild
	institution_spread_to_subject = monthly_institution_spread_mild

	overlord_modifier = {
		naval_range_modifier = 0.05
	}
	subject_modifier = {
		global_max_control = 0.05
		loyalty_to_overlord = 10
	}

	creation_visible = {
		oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
	}
	visible = {
		oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
		scope:target ?= {
			NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_yp_xingsheng }
			NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_yp_frontier }
		}
	}
	visible_through_diplomacy = { always = no }
	enabled_through_diplomacy = { always = no }
	visible_through_treaty = { always = no }

	on_enable = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_name_full_title value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel_named_duhu value = 1 }
		scope:future_overlord ?= { save_scope_as = oe_cel_lord }
		oe_cel_apply_track_subject_flavor = yes
		scope:future_overlord ?= { oe_cel_sync_duhu_count = yes }
	}
	on_disable = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_named_duhu }
			remove_variable = oe_name_full_title
			remove_variable = oe_cel_named_duhu
		}
		oe_cel_clear_track_subject_flavor = yes
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:former_overlord }
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_former_subject_of value = scope:former_overlord }
		}
	}
}
